name: version-copies
rule: Edit the existing file in place. Do not create -v2, -final or copy files; keep at most the current and the previous version.

name: delete-results
rule: Datasets and finished results are never deleted without the user's explicit confirmation. List what would be removed and ask.

name: outward-action
rule: Outward actions stay drafts. Prepare the message or post and wait for an explicit instruction to send or publish.

name: verify-before-done
pattern: \b(is it done|did it work|does it work|is it working|verify|double[- ]check)\b
rule: Check the result yourself before reporting: run it, render it or open it, and separate what you verified from what you assume.

name: many-requests
rule: This prompt holds several requests. Keep a numbered ledger and report each item as done, in progress or unverified.
